name: Kwikset Halo Touch (US)

radios.note: Connects directly to your home Wi-Fi. The Wi-Fi band is not stated on the pages we saw.

matter.note: Neither Halo Touch page mentions Matter; Kwikset sells Matter under its Halo Select line. No CSA listing was checked. Absence is not a no.

apple_home.note: Neither Halo Touch page mentions Apple Home or HomeKit; the product page lists only Alexa, Google Home and Brilliant.

google_home.note: Kwikset lists Google Assistant and Google Home as compatible.

alexa.note: Kwikset lists Amazon Alexa as compatible.

smartthings.note: Neither Halo Touch page mentions SmartThings.

home_assistant.note: No official Home Assistant or Kwikset page for this model was found.

hubRequired.note: Wi-Fi is built in; the Kwikset app manages the lock.

localControl.note: Kwikset says fingerprint images are stored locally on the lock, but does not state whether app or voice control works without the cloud.

lockFit.note: Sold as a deadbolt with a Contemporary or Traditional style. A key works as backup.

keypad.note: Kwikset lists fingerprint (up to 100 prints, 50 users) and a key as the ways in. Neither page says whether there is a keypad, so this stays unconfirmed.

summary: A fingerprint deadbolt with Wi-Fi built in, the Kwikset Halo Touch works with Alexa and Google Home and needs no hub. It holds up to 100 prints for 50 users, has a key as backup, and runs on four AA batteries. Kwikset's pages don't confirm Apple Home, SmartThings or Matter for it.
caveats: Apple Home, SmartThings and Matter support is not confirmed for this model.
Kwikset doesn't say whether it has a keypad, or which Wi-Fi band it uses.
